title: Subordinated principal and the reported 2013 repayment
summary: Reported year-end subordinated principal is $9 million in 2011, $9 million in 2012 and $4 million in 2013. The 2013 note reports $5 million principal repaid to NAYS on October 8 plus unquantified unpaid interest.
limitation: Endpoint arithmetic is not a complete gross borrowing or cash-flow bridge. Repayment is source-reported, not independently authenticated. The unnamed member in earlier notes is not identified as Bleich; unpaid interest is unknown, not zero.
